mood: Fast, sleek and nostalgic: a synthwave sunset highway seen from the driver's seat.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid violet with a pink/cyan edge glow on hover
shape.texture: scanlines over a perspective grid floor

motifs: neon road edges (pink left, cyan right)
buttonStyle: Primary is an italic black-weight button with a pink-to-magenta gradient and a cyan underline sweep on hover; secondary is a transparent button with a cyan outline.
backdrop: Static sun and skyline with a CSS perspective grid whose lines scroll toward the viewer slowly (background-position only), with a faint pink horizon glow.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
